title: Sad Heart on Tropical Island
coreRelationships: The sad heart character is the central and largest element, positioned in the lower-middle of the frame.
The tropical island environment with palm trees, ocean, and sunset forms the backdrop for the heart.
The dolphins in the sky and birds near the sun add dynamic elements to the upper portion of the scene.
The halftone texture is consistently applied across all elements, unifying the visual style.
reuseFormula: Recreate a vibrant, cartoon-style tropical island scene with a prominent, sad, anthropomorphic red heart as the central figure. Apply a consistent halftone dot pattern to all colors. Include a sunset, ocean, palm trees, dolphins, and birds. Maintain a high-saturation color palette with thick black outlines for all elements.
